categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor key management and parsing APIs in src/script/descriptor.{h,cpp} designed directly for wallet descriptor workflows and GUI wallet setup flows.
categories.rationale: Exposes standalone descriptor key expression parsing and origin inspection to support the GUI multisig setup wizard. As the author notes, this enables the GUI flow to 'validate input, inspect the parsed key, and apply setup-specific policy' for tracking issue #35645, alongside a minor parsing fix for trailing characters in musig descriptors.
